assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: flat 2D panoramic skyline backdrop to be placed behind 3D apartment windows in Penthouse 22.
Scene/backdrop: Tokyo at night, a dense layered skyline of modern high-rises and smaller urban buildings, with the recognizable red-orange illuminated lattice Tokyo Tower rising clearly above the surrounding city.
Style/medium: stylized cinematic architectural concept artwork, polished digital matte painting with crisp architectural silhouettes, restrained painterly detail, and subtle atmospheric depth.
Composition/framing: one wide landscape image, 1536x1024 pixels or the same 3:2 aspect ratio. Unobstructed view from high-rise elevation looking outward across the city, near-level camera with a slight downward view. The city and all landmark silhouettes occupy the lower 60% of the frame; keep the upper 40% as spacious deep navy night sky. Landmark fully visible and clearly recognizable at backdrop scale, with readable layers of buildings across the width.
Lighting/mood: full nighttime, deep navy sky and cool dark building shadows, warm amber illuminated windows and street lights, subtle cinematic glow.
Constraints: exterior cityscape only; no interiors, furniture, window frames, glass reflections, balcony railings, people, typography, lettering, labels, logos, watermark, borders, or collage. Generate exactly one complete image, no variants.
